name: Recall@5
one_line: The same measure at rank 5. Harder, and more sensitive to reranking.

formula.notation: R@5 = |{ q in Q : max grade(c) >= 2 for c in top_5(q) }| / |Q|

terms.meaning: the five chunks ranked highest for q

range.note: Mathematical range. No typical value is stated: it would be a number with no run behind it.

ci.why: A point estimate over a few hundred queries without an interval is the first thing a reviewer attacks.
